introduction: Missouri LIHEAP offers Energy Assistance and crisis help through contracted local agencies. Funding and seasonal windows affect availability.
description: Missouri LIHEAP offers Energy Assistance and crisis help through contracted local agencies. Funding and seasonal windows affect availability.

sections.who: Applicants must meet residency, income, utility responsibility and other conditions. Renters can qualify.
sections.get: Energy Assistance supports a fuel cost; ECIP addresses qualifying disconnection or fuel emergencies.
sections.docs:
• Income and household records.
  • Energy account and bill details.
  • Termination notices or evidence of low fuel.
sections.apply:
1. Find the contracted agency

    Use DSS LIHEAP.

  2. Apply

    Follow online upload instructions or submit by mail, fax or in person.

  3. Explain the crisis

    Give the exact disconnect date or fuel situation; confirm current ECIP funding.
sections.after: Keep paying bills when possible and contact the utility about disconnection.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using Missouri LIHEAP and ECIP. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.

faqs: Yes, when responsible for eligible utilities.
